description.value: You apply the outdated technique of clustering identical systems to form a parallel computing cluster to your magic, allowing you to manage more than one piece of overclocked gear at once. You can have up to two pieces of overclocked gear at once, and you overclock up to two pieces of gear whenever you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Overclock Gear]. Only one piece of overclocked gear is no longer overclocked when you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Jailbreak Spell].
